item.title: Building k9s for Linode With Bubble Tea
item.description:
A lot of my day is spent in k9s. Sometimes I need something from the Linode side of the house. Maybe it’s a node that won’t boot, a volume nobody cleaned up or the kubeconfig for a cluster I just made. Then I’m back in a browser tab or typing linode-cli incantations. I wanted the k9s workflow for the Linode API itself:

  • : to jump to a resource type
  • / to filter
  • single-key actions on the selected row
  • Enter to go deeper

That turned into linode-tui. It’s a Go TUI built on Bubble Tea, linodego and urfave/cli v3.

item.title: Stop Ctrl-C-ing Your tail -f | grep
item.description:
Here’s a loop I end up in all the time:

  • tail -f app.log
  • something scrolls by that looks wrong, Ctrl-C
  • tail -f app.log | grep ERROR and wait for it to happen again
  • decide I also want to drop the health checks, Ctrl-C
  • | grep -v healthz and wait again

Every filter tweak throws away the stream and every line that already went past. I got tired of it and wrote tail-gunner. It’s a tail replacement that you can promote into a filtering TUI with one keystroke. You can drop back out of it without the stream ever stopping.
